axis: one set move in a game → a line of action a person or group takes on

members.tone: Stresses size and order: a plan with many worked-out parts, more elaborate than a plain *plan*.
A plan set in advance that a sports team runs during a game, far narrower than a *scheme*.
Puts the weight on method: the steps or process you follow to reach a goal.
A plan a person or group has chosen and taken on as their own; the stress is on that choice.
